name: PT Asuransi Jasa Tania Tbk
summary: PT Asuransi Jasa Tania Tbk provides general insurance products and services in Indonesia. The company offers standard products, such as fire insurance comprising property all risk/industrial all risk and earthquake insurance; motor vehicle insurance; engineering insurance, including contractor, erection, and machinery breakdown insurance; marine cargo and hull insurance; surety bond comprising bid bond, performance bond, advance payment bond, and maintenance bond; personal accident insurance; and miscellaneous insurance, including cash in transit/cash in safe, burglary/theft, heavy equipment, and hole in one insurance.
